## ApprovalDeniedOutcome.failure property

Set when the provider itself misbehaved rather than reporting a state. The call is denied either way; this distinguishes "a human declined" from "the approval channel is broken" for operators, and is the only part of a provider failure that is safe to surface.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly failure?: ApprovalFailure | undefined;
```
